C0188.title: Yanggu Police Dismantle Online Water Army Hubs Using Group-Control Devices to Inflate Livestream Viewer Numbers
C0188.summary: In February 2025, police in Yanggu County, Shandong Province, dismantled two online water army hubs. Suspects used group-control devices to generate fake engagement for livestream rooms, illegally manipulating large numbers of accounts to simulate real user interactions in order to boost livestream metrics and profit from the scheme.
